title: The 7th Guest intermittent music stutter
symptom: Music occasionally contains a brief stutter or repetition glitch during otherwise working playback.
expected: Music remains continuous and correctly synchronized without intermittent repeated or stalled samples.

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: A short-lived CDIC or VMPEG audio-buffer underrun, duplicate presentation event, or host-output starvation may repeat the most recent samples before normal delivery resumes.
supporting_evidence: The fault is occasional and brief rather than a permanent loop.
The same run otherwise preserves MPEG progression, gameplay, and audio termination.
contradicting_evidence: The exact scene and whether the affected music is VMPEG MP2, CDIC XA/CD-DA, or another title-controlled source are not yet recorded.
No core PCM, mixed PCM, CPAL callback, or underflow event has been captured at the audible glitch.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Reproduce while recording source-selection, CDIC and VMPEG buffer events, pre-mix PCM hashes, mixed-output hashes, and CPAL callback occupancy. If all emulator stages are continuous and only the host capture stutters, the emulated-device explanation is false.

manual_verification.notes: The user reports a pre-existing intermittent fault: music occasionally has a small stutter glitch during otherwise working The 7th Guest playback. The exact scene and audio source have not yet been isolated.
